nodes.name: test_delivery_summary.sql
nodes.summary: End-to-end delivery lifecycle test harness for a single order, providing SELECT queries against all four delivery tables (summary, detail, dispatch, inflight), cleanup DELETE/UPDATE statements, and manual calls to process_delivery(), job_create_dispatch(), job_assign_dispatch(), and dispatch_complete_func().

nodes.name: test_driverNotify.sql
nodes.summary: Test fixture for the rider notification and dispatch-assignment flow: seeds delivery_dispatch with accepted rows for multiple orders, calls assign_accepted_dispatch() and notify_missed_dispatches(), and includes cleanup statements to reset state between runs.

nodes.name: test_jobs_sequentially.sql
nodes.summary: Sequential execution script for manually calling the pg_cron job stored procedures (job_create_dispatch, job_assign_dispatch, job_process_owntracks) in order to test the full dispatch pipeline step-by-step.

nodes.name: test_location_setup.sql
nodes.summary: Setup and inspection queries for live location tracking tests, inserting rider_location rows and verifying delivery_inflight state to validate the OwnTracks ingestion pipeline.

nodes.name: test_manage_init_delivery_detail.sql
nodes.summary: Development test script for manage_delivery_detail() and job_assign_delivery() stored procedures, including inspection of delivery_detail status transitions, vehicle_type_timedout handling, and a debug CTE verifying the rank-based rider assignment logic.

nodes.name: test_rider_agent.sql
nodes.summary: Targeted queries and state-reset statements for testing the LangGraph rider agent, including inspection of delivery_inflight, delivery_dispatch, and thread tables, plus reset procedures to re-run agent scenarios.

nodes.name: test_takeaway.sql
nodes.summary: Takeaway-specific test harness mirroring test_delivery_summary.sql, providing takeaway_summary inspection, delivery table cleanup, and manual invocations of the process_delivery and dispatch job stored procedures for WREN restaurant orders.
